start.speaker: Nettle
start.text: Mind where you put the boots. Whatever is on them came out of the overflow and it is patient. I have been minding my boots for years. Are you going up? I can walk. I have been telling myself that for a while now.

choices.text: I am going down, not up.

taken.speaker: Nettle
taken.text: Fine. I know the safe stones; you know the way through. We trade those until the ascent.

left.speaker: Nettle
left.text: Then go carefully. I will keep the bad water off this landing until you return.

committed.speaker: Nettle
committed.text: I will follow the sound of your boots until the way out.

already.speaker: An empty landing
already.text: Somebody sat here long enough to wear the stone smooth. Whoever it was is not sitting here now.
